prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop landing-page direction comp, 1440×900 landscape, edge to edge, no browser frame or device.
Primary request: tienda provisional colombiana de impresión 3D llamada “Forma 3D”; visitor understands it sells professionally printed objects and can explore the catalog.
Real visible content: “Hecho con precisión”, “Impresión 3D profesional para objetos disponibles y piezas bajo pedido.”, CTA “Explorar productos”, price sample “$ 89.000 COP”, status “Disponible”, links “Productos”, “Personalizados”, “Cómo fabricamos”, “WhatsApp”.
Composition: an oversized human production-traveler sheet is the working storefront itself—message, finished 3D-printed object, price, stock and CTA arranged with the direct logic of a shop-floor job ticket, but warm and commercial rather than bureaucratic. One large product photograph/3D render is the subject. The first viewport reveals the beginning of a featured-products section below with a different composition.
Visual law: pale workshop-paper ground, deep forest ink, vivid vermilion action, mist-green surface; bold utilitarian sans display plus highly readable text; stamped marks and registration blocks appear only where they communicate real status. Materials feel like paper, rubber ink and matte filament.
One dominant sheet; all interface remains legible and clickable.
Constraints: no gradients, no glass, no floating pill nav, no icon-card row, no fake reviews, discounts or statistics, no lorem ipsum, no browser chrome, no mockup device.
